tools.name: redact
tools.description: Redact personal data (email, phone, cards, SA ID, SSN, IP, IBAN, names, custom terms) from text, replacing each value with a stable token like [EMAIL_1]. Call this before putting sensitive text into a prompt or context. NOTE: detection is automated and is not a guarantee; it can miss personal data.

tools.name: detect_pii
tools.description: Report what personal data appears in text (counts by type) without returning the raw values. Use to check whether text is safe to share. NOTE: detection is automated and is not a guarantee; a clean result does not prove the text is free of personal data.

tools.name: redact_document
tools.description: Redact PII from an uploaded file or document before sharing it with an AI. Works on PDFs, Word (.docx), Excel (.xlsx), and text-based files (txt, csv, json, code, transcripts, logs). Pass base64 file data with media_type/filename, OR raw text. Returns the redacted text and counts. Requires your work

tools.name: list_detectors
tools.description: List the PII types this shield can mask, and confirm custom regex/terms are supported. Call this to see what coverage is available.

tools.name: get_coverage
tools.description: Show your workspace's current PII coverage (which detectors are on, custom terms, custom patterns). Uses the workspace key from your MCP server URL.

tools.name: set_coverage
tools.description: Change what this workspace masks, right from your chat. Turn detectors on/off (e.g. enable PERSON name masking), add always-mask terms, or add custom PII as regex (e.g. employee IDs 'EMP-\\d{5}'). Uses the workspace key from your MCP server URL.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_coverage · Private data: redact, redact_document · Public sink: redact, detect_pii.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_coverage · Private data: redact, redact_document · Public sink: redact, detect_pii

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
